'''Miles''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for [[House of Thul|House Thul]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. An electronics expert, he came up with a way to retake the [[Thul droid factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]&mdash;dataspikes inserted in the factory's terminals allowed him to remotely shut down the factory, retaking it from [[House Ulgo]].
